bio: Famous sommelier Marcos Granda has returned to his roots to create this project that places service in the dining room on an equal footing with events in the kitchen, as he views a balance between both these aspects as the key to success. In the elegant dining room, decked out in stylish wood, the aim is to give centre-stage to the splendid kitchen, where chef Marcos Mistry cooks live in front of a maximum of just a dozen guests.
